subject: general
question: In India, Micro Finance Institutions primarily target which segment of the population?
solution:
The correct answer is **Low-income individuals and small businesses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Micro Finance Institutions (MFIs)** are financial entities that provide small loans to people who do not have access to traditional banking services.
 
• In India, MFIs primarily target **low-income individuals** and **small businesses** to help them improve their livelihoods.
 
• These institutions aim to promote **financial inclusion** by providing credit to those who are underserved by formal financial institutions.
 
• MFIs often provide **loans** for purposes such as starting or expanding a small business, education, healthcare, and housing.
 
• By targeting low-income segments, MFIs help in **poverty alleviation** and economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Microfinance Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Microcredit**
 Small loans given to individuals or small businesses to meet their financial needs.
 
 

 **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**
 Groups of 10-20 people, usually women, who pool their savings and lend to members.
 
 

 **Joint Liability Groups (JLGs)**
 Groups of individuals who take loans collectively and are jointly liable for repayment.
 
 

 **Financial Inclusion**
 Ensuring access to financial services for all segments of society, particularly the underserved.
 
 

 **Micro Savings**
 Small savings accounts offered to low-income individuals to encourage saving habits.
 
 

 **Micro Insurance**
 Insurance products designed to be affordable for low-income individuals.
